name: ARES Terminal Console
description: Split-pane terminals with tabs, broadcast, sessions that outlive the browser and a record of every connection and command, plus read-only server tools and an AI command assistant. Runs as a web application with user administration, two-factor authentication and single sign-on (Microsoft Entra ID, SAML 2.0, LDAP / Active Directory), and as a login-free desktop app for Linux, macOS and Windows. Backups to local, SFTP and S3, API tokens, audit log and SIEM forwarding.

server.install: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt

brand.tagline: Split-pane terminals for operators: on the web with sign-in, 2FA and SSO, or on the desktop with nothing in the way.
brand.author: Alfredo Nacino
